{"_meta":{"io.modelcontextprotocol/serverInfo":{"description":"Context7 provides up-to-date documentation and code examples for libraries and frameworks.","icons":[{"mimeType":"image/svg+xml","sizes":["any"],"src":"https://context7.com/context7-icon-green.svg"},{"mimeType":"image/png","sizes":["512x512"],"src":"https://context7.com/context7-icon-green.png"}],"name":"Context7","title":"Context7","version":"4.4.2","websiteUrl":"https://context7.com"}},"content":[{"text":"### vm.runInNewContext(code[, contextObject[, options]])\n\nSource: https://github.com/nodejs/node/blob/main/doc/api/vm.md\n\nCompiles code as a vm.Script, runs it inside a newly created context, and returns the result. The code does not have access to the local scope in which this method is called.\n\n```APIDOC\n### Signature\n`vm.runInNewContext(code[, contextObject[, options]])`\n\n### Description\n1. Creates a new context.\n2. If `contextObject` is an object, contextifies it with the new context. If `contextObject` is undefined, creates a new object and contextifies it. If `contextObject` is `vm.constants.DONT_CONTEXTIFY`, does not contextify anything.\n3. Compiles the code as a `vm.Script`.\n4. Runs the compiled code within the created context. The code does not have access to the scope in which this method is called.\n5. Returns the result.\n\n### Parameters\n- **code** (string) - Required - The JavaScript code to compile and run.\n- **contextObject** (Object | vm.constants.DONT_CONTEXTIFY) - Optional - An object to contextify. If undefined, a new object is created and contextified. If `vm.constants.DONT_CONTEXTIFY`, contextification is skipped.\n- **options** (Object) - Optional - Execution options.\n\n### Returns\n- Returns the result of running the script.\n\n### Examples\n\n**ES Module (mjs):**\n```mjs\nimport { runInNewContext, constants } from 'node:vm';\n\nconst contextObject = {\n  animal: 'cat',\n  count: 2,\n};\n\nrunInNewContext('count += 1; name = \"kitty\"', contextObject);\nconsole.log(contextObject);\n// Prints: { animal: 'cat', count: 3, name: 'kitty' }\n\nconst frozenContext = runInNewContext(\n  'Object.freeze(globalThis); globalThis;',\n  constants.DONT_CONTEXTIFY,\n);\n```\n\n**CommonJS (cjs):**\n```cjs\nconst { runInNewContext, constants } = require('node:vm');\n\nconst contextObject = {\n  animal: 'cat',\n  count: 2,\n};\n\nrunInNewContext('count += 1; name = \"kitty\"', contextObject);\nconsole.log(contextObject);\n// Prints: { animal: 'cat', count: 3, name: 'kitty' }\n\nconst frozenContext = runInNewContext(\n  'Object.freeze(globalThis); globalThis;',\n  constants.DONT_CONTEXTIFY,\n);\n```\n```\n\n--------------------------------\n\n### Execute code within a contextified object using vm.runInContext\n\nSource: https://github.com/nodejs/node/blob/main/doc/api/vm.md\n\nCompiles and executes scripts within the context of a contextified global object. The target object must be initialized using vm.createContext() before execution.\n\n```mjs\nimport { createContext, runInContext } from 'node:vm';\n\nconst contextObject = { globalVar: 1 };\ncreateContext(contextObject);\n\nfor (let i = 0; i < 10; ++i) {\n  runInContext('globalVar *= 2;', contextObject);\n}\nconsole.log(contextObject);\n// Prints: { globalVar: 1024 }\n```\n\n```cjs\nconst { createContext, runInContext } = require('node:vm');\n\nconst contextObject = { globalVar: 1 };\ncreateContext(contextObject);\n\nfor (let i = 0; i < 10; ++i) {\n  runInContext('globalVar *= 2;', contextObject);\n}\nconsole.log(contextObject);\n// Prints: { globalVar: 1024 }\n```\n\n--------------------------------\n\n### vm.createContext([contextObject[, options]])\n\nSource: https://github.com/nodejs/node/blob/main/doc/api/vm.md\n\nPrepares an object to be used as a global execution context in vm execution methods. If omitted or undefined, a new empty contextified object is created.\n\n```APIDOC\n## `vm.createContext([contextObject[, options]])`\n\n### Description\nPrepares a given `contextObject` and returns a reference to it so that it can be used in calls to `vm.runInContext()` or `script.runInContext()`. Inside such scripts, the global object is wrapped by `contextObject`.\n\n### Parameters\n- **contextObject** (`Object` | `vm.constants.DONT_CONTEXTIFY` | `undefined`, optional) - Either `vm.constants.DONT_CONTEXTIFY` or an object to be contextified. If `undefined`, an empty contextified object will be created.\n- **options** (`Object`, optional)\n  - **name** (`string`, optional) - Human-readable name of the newly created context. Default: `'VM Context i'` (where `i` is an ascending numerical index).\n  - **origin** (`string`, optional) - Origin corresponding to the newly created context for display purposes. Default: `''`.\n  - **codeGeneration** (`Object`, optional)\n    - **strings** (`boolean`, optional) - If set to `false`, any calls to `eval` or function constructors (`Function`, `GeneratorFunction`, etc.) will throw an `EvalError`. Default: `true`.\n    - **wasm** (`boolean`, optional) - If set to `false`, any attempt to compile a WebAssembly module will throw a `WebAssembly.CompileError`
